queries.name: Read workshop / Production records
queries.sql: SELECT id, work_order, machine, quantity, status FROM production_records ORDER BY id

queries.name: Read workshop / Typed quantity
queries.sql: SELECT id, machine, quantity FROM production_records WHERE quantity >= @minimum ORDER BY id

queries.name: Read workshop / Slow read for cancellation
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE sequence(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM sequence WHERE n < 500000000) SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM sequence

props.text: Open Named queries in Designer. Run Typed quantity with minimum 45, then try invalid text. Run Slow read with a 1-second deadline; repeat with 30 seconds and press Cancel read query. Finally run Production records again to verify recovery.
LOCAL SQLITE EXAMPLE · Slow reads are run deliberately in Designer only. No timer, runtime binding or update query runs the slow operation.
